prompt: A lighthouse under construction on a small rocky islet in the open sea, seen from slightly above, its round stone tower only half built and wrapped in fine wooden scaffolding with ladders and a small wooden crane, drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, small ripples around the rocks. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no horizon, no sky, no clouds, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, the lighthouse small on the left third, open water on the right. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of seaweed green #5d7a6a.
